visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up view of a white ceramic bowl containing a dark soy sauce base. Sliced red chili rings and garlic cloves are mixed within. A stainless steel spoon stirs the mixture, causing ripples and moving the solid ingredients around. (2) Medium shot of a middle-aged woman with short, dark hair wearing a navy blue short-sleeved shirt. She is seated at a glass dining table, gesturing actively with her right hand while looking towards someone off-camera. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of a spoon lifting a piece of translucent white food garnish, which is topped with a red chili and garlic slice from the sauce bowl. Background dishes with chicken and noodles are blurry. (4) Return to the woman at the dining table. She uses both hands to gesture, illustrating proportions. On the table, there is a glass of orange juice and a glass of red wine. Soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (5) A close-up shot of a younger woman with dark hair. She takes a bite of the food from the spoon. Her eyes widen slightly as she chews, and she touches her cheek, exhibiting a satisfied and happy facial expression.
